# PdfSize

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Represents the size of a PDF page in points. Includes standard page sizes (A4, Letter, etc.) and helper methods for orientation and unit conversion.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new PdfSize(width: number, height: number, name?: string)
```

## Properties

- [`a0`](#a0): ISO A0 size (841 x 1189 mm).
- [`a1`](#a1): ISO A1 size (594 x 841 mm).
- [`a2`](#a2): ISO A2 size (420 x 594 mm).
- [`a3`](#a3): ISO A3 size (297 x 420 mm).
- [`a4`](#a4): ISO A4 size (210 x 297 mm).
- [`a5`](#a5): ISO A5 size (148 x 210 mm).
- [`b0`](#b0): ISO B0 size (1000 x 1414 mm).
- [`b1`](#b1): ISO B1 size (707 x 1000 mm).
- [`b2`](#b2): ISO B2 size (500 x 707 mm).
- [`b3`](#b3): ISO B3 size (353 x 500 mm).
- [`b4`](#b4): ISO B4 size (250 x 353 mm).
- [`b5`](#b5): ISO B5 size (176 x 250 mm).
- [`executive`](#executive): Executive size (7.25 x 10.5 inches).
- [`height`](#height): Page height in points (1/72 inch).
- [`isLandscape`](#islandscape): Gets a value indicating whether the size is landscape (Width > Height).
- [`isPortrait`](#isportrait): Gets a value indicating whether the size is portrait (Height >= Width).
- [`ledger`](#ledger): Ledger size (17 x 11 inches).
- [`legal`](#legal): Legal size (8.5 x 14 inches).
- [`letter`](#letter): Letter size (8.5 x 11 inches).
- [`name`](#name): Optional display name of the size, such as `'A4'`.
- [`statement`](#statement): Statement size (5.5 x 8.5 inches).
- [`tabloid`](#tabloid): Tabloid size (11 x 17 inches).
- [`width`](#width): Page width in points (1/72 inch).

## Methods

- [`fromInches`](#frominches): Creates a PdfSize from dimensions in inches.
- [`fromMM`](#frommm): Creates a PdfSize from dimensions in millimeters.
- [`getOrientedSize`](#getorientedsize): Returns a new PdfSize adjusted for the specified orientation.
- [`landscape`](#landscape): Returns a new PdfSize in landscape orientation (Width > Height).
- [`portrait`](#portrait): Returns a new PdfSize in portrait orientation (Height >= Width).


- `name`: - Optional name of the page size
